title: SimpleVerify
description: SimpleVerify is a lightweight plugin that ensures secure Discord verification for your Minecraft server, requiring users to verify via their Discord accounts before playing.
body:
# SimpleVerify

SimpleVerify is a lightweight and powerful plugin that provides a secure, seamless Discord verification system for your Minecraft server. By requiring users to verify their Discord account, you ensure a trusted and connected community. It integrates directly with Discord, assigning roles automatically based on verification status, and is fully customizable via the config file. Admins benefit from a dedicated dashboard, where they can manage verification statuses, timeouts, and notifications. With support for multiple languages, you can easily adapt it to your community.

## ✨ Features
- Easy verification via Discord bot
- `/verify` command for players
- Automatic role assignment (e.g., LuckPerms integration)
- Admin dashboard for managing verification
- Configurable commands and roles
- Multi-language support (English, German, and more)
- Minimal resource usage
- Fully customizable via config

## ⚙️ Configurable Options
- Customize verification roles
- Set timeout durations for verification
- Adjust notifications (e.g., Discord alerts)
- Multi-language settings in the config file

## 📜 Commands
- `/verify` – Players verify themselves with their Discord account
- `/verify admin` – Open the admin panel
- `/verify status` – Check the player’s verification status

## 📊 Statistics
- Verified players are stored in a database table
- Admins can view stats in the dashboard

## 🌍 Multi-language Support
- Choose your language (English, German, and more)
- Selectable default language
- All messages and commands are fully localized

## 📥 Installation
1. Download the plugin.
2. Add it to your PaperMC server.
3. Adjust the configuration.
4. Start the server and check the logs.

## 📌 Note
This plugin is fully compatible with LuckPerms and other permissions systems. The integration with Discord provides a smooth experience for players. Visit our Discord for support: [discord.siuuuhd.de](https://discord.siuuuhd.de)
